test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 2021 marked the 145th birth anniversary of the designer of the Indian National Tricolour. What was his/her name?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pingali Venkayya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi **paid homage** to the designer of the Indian National flag, **Pingali Venkayya** on his birth anniversary.
 
• **Pingali Venkayya **was an **Indian freedom fighter and a Gandhian.**** **
 
• He was the** designer of the flag **on which the **Indian National Flag was based.**
 
• He was also a** lecturer, author, geologist, educationalist, agriculturist, and polyglot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/407bd04c68c8e8f9a074a13d9f2853a9510ec9e1edf3029bc201c2c7acb70175.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhikaiji Rustom Cama** or simply, **Madam Cama, **was one of the **prominent figures** in the Indian independence movement.​ 
 
• **Bankim Chandra Chatterjee** CIE was an Indian novelist, poet, and journalist.
 
• **Annie Besant** was a British socialist, theosophist, women's rights activist, writer, orator, political party member, educationist, and philanthropist.
